Executive Summary of CRADA Work: This project will assess the performance of an innovative high efficiency air conditioner integrated with a composite phase change material (PCM). The research will address critical electric grid challenges by evaluating the thermal efficiency and load-shifting capabilities in NREL’s HVAC characterization lab. Task # Task Title Expected Results 1 Modeling and design HVAC system design, including PCM thermal storage module 2 Prototype Lab characterization of gen-1 prototype (composite PCM characterization thermal storage module and HVAC system) experiments 3 Gen-2 design Updated models; 2nd generation design of composite PCM thermal storage module; modifications, as needed, to HVAC system prototype 4 Gen-2 prototype Characterization of 2nd generation prototype (new bench-scale characterization and composite PCM thermal storage module) integration experiments 5 Building modeling
